title: OpenCode Go visual infrastructure cohort
description: Four OpenCode Go models attempted the visual metrics-regression incident five times each, testing whether they could correlate noisy dashboard signals and converge on a durable repair.
observations: All four models completed all five attempts: 20 evaluated trials, 20 durable repairs, and no unavailable runs.
DeepSeek V4 Flash was fastest at a 1:22 median; MiniMax M3 and Qwen 3.8 Max were close at 2:16 and 2:17, while Kimi K3 was 3:04.
The cohort measures durable infrastructure repair from visual evidence, not image captioning or general coding ability.
notes: This is an OpenCode Go subscription cohort and is intentionally published separately from Claux/OpenRouter results.
All lanes use the same visual scenario, scenario-pack revision, Replaybook host harness, five-attempt design, and 900-second timeout.
OpenCode Go does not report per-trial provider costs in the adapter output; cost is therefore shown as unavailable rather than estimated.
reproduction_command: python integrations/host/run_host_matrix.py --scenario-pack ../replaybook-infra --scenario 030-visual-metrics-regression --models opencode-go/qwen3.8-max opencode-go/minimax-m3 opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash opencode-go/kimi-k3 --reasoning-efforts high --agent-adapter integrations/host/adapters/opencode.sh --agent-payload ~/.opencode/bin/opencode --agent-env-file <prepared-opencode-env> --agent-name opencode --attempts 5 --concurrency 1 --base-port 28200
